mechanisms.title: Text Determination
mechanisms.memory_hook: Text is master data with a search strategy.
failure_proof: missing text → procedure assignment + text type + access sequence + source text + copy/reference behavior
stale follow-on text → prove copy from predecessor vs redetermination

mechanisms.title: Output Management
mechanisms.memory_hook: The document exists. Output decides who actually hears about it.
mechanisms.debug_path: business object exists → output item → determination result → recipient → channel → dispatch time/status → render/send error
